summary: Last known L-5 cab, Okanogan NF; built 1933 or 1934 (sources differ); probably abandoned 1941; volunteers restored it in 2013; hike-in only.

staffing.status: no current staffing reported; historically staffed temporarily during high fire danger

access.note: Hike-in site on national forest land. The sources read give no closure notice or entry rule for the cab and no current trail report.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in only. The 2013 chapter report describes brushing out 8+ miles of trail to the lookout. Check current trail conditions with the Methow Valley Ranger District before going.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Okanogan National Forest

events.note: firelookout.com gives 1933 for the L-5 cab; TrailChick gives 1934 for the current structure
firelookout.com says the cab was probably abandoned in 1941
Two FFLA members hiked in and found it severely neglected; a helicopter brought materials for emergency repairs. firelookout.com records some preservation work in 2002
Trail cleared by Scurlock and volunteers; foundation and roof repaired, walls repaired, lightning rod installed. MVFFLA calls this the last restoration work on Mebee
$200 grant from the Chuck Butler Memorial Lookout Restoration Fund plus a $500 donation from the chapter

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1933 for the L-5 cab; TrailChick gives 1934 for the current structure and 1930s for site establishment. The record keeps 1933 from firelookout.com and flags the disagreement.
NHLR gives 6,972 ft (2,125 m), TrailChick gives 6,960 ft, and firelookout.com gives 7482 ft. The record keeps the NHLR value of 2125.1 m.
NHLR gives Skagit County. firelookout.com gives Okanogan/Skagit County. The record keeps Skagit as the brief has it.

sources.title: Forest Fire Lookout Association chapter report, 2013 (cr-ewa-2013.pdf)

notes_for_editor: The brief's 2023 shutter event is left out: the MVFFLA post is dated only 'Apr 14' on the cached copy and no year appears, so the year is unconfirmed. The 1933 vs 1934 build-year conflict is unresolved. Page reads used: NHLR, MVFFLA, the 2013 PDF (grep), TrailChick, firelookout.com, and the Weebly index (navigation only, no lookout detail). No WebSearch was used.
